title: Eagle-Holy Cross Janitorial Sources Sought
agency: AGRICULTURE, DEPARTMENT OF > FOREST SERVICE > USDA-FS, CSA INTERMOUNTAIN 4
description:
1. Purpose  
The Government is conducting market research to identify qualified small business concerns capable  
of providing comprehensive janitorial services in Eagle, Colorado. The information collected will  
be used to determine the availability and capability of small businesses and specific socioeconomic  
categories for a potential set-aside acquisition. 
This RFI is issued solely for planning and market research purposes and does not constitute a  
solicitation, request for proposal (RFP), invitation for bid (IFB), or a commitment by the  
Government to award a contract. 

  2. Background  
The Government is seeking information from contractors capable of providing routine and periodic  
janitorial services for a federal facility located in Eagle, Colorado. Services may include, but  
are not limited to: 
•  Daily and weekly custodial cleaning 
•  Restroom sanitation and replenishment 
•  Trash collection and disposal 
•  Floor maintenance 
•  Carpet cleaning 
•  Window cleaning 
•  High-touch surface disinfection 
•  Supply management 
•  Emergency cleaning services 

 The anticipated service area is Eagle County, Colorado. 

  3. Socioeconomic Categories of Interest  
The Government is particularly interested in responses from firms in the following categories: 
•  Small Business (SB) 
•  Woman-Owned Small Business (WOSB) 
•  Economically Disadvantaged Woman-Owned Small Business (EDWOSB) 
•  Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Business (SDVOSB) 
•  Veteran-Owned Small Business (VOSB) 
•  HUBZone Small Business 
•  Small Disadvantaged Business (SDB) 
•  SBA Certified 8(a) Business Development Program Participants 
Contractors should indicate all applicable socioeconomic certifications and provide supporting  
documentation if available. 

  
 4. Geographic Capability  
Respondents should address: 
1. Physical office location(s). 
2. Service coverage within Eagle County and surrounding areas. 
3. Distance from Eagle, Colorado. 
4. Existing contracts currently performed in western Colorado or mountain communities. 
5. Ability to recruit and retain janitorial personnel in the Eagle Valley region. 

  
 5. Information Requested  
Interested vendors should provide the following: 
Company Information 
•  Company name 

 •  UEI 
•  CAGE Code 
•  Business address 
•  Point of contact 
•  Telephone number 
•  Email address 
•  Business size status under NAICS 561720 
Socioeconomic Status 
Identify all applicable categories: 
☐ Small Business 
☐ WOSB 
☐ EDWOSB 
☐ HUBZone 
☐ SDVOSB 
☐ VOSB 
☐ SDB 
☐ SBA 8(a) 
Experience 
Provide a brief description of at least three similar contracts performed within the last five  
years, including: 
•  Customer name 
•  Contract number (if public) 
•  Period of performance 
•  Annual dollar value 
•  Scope of work 
•  Location 
Staffing Capability 
Provide information regarding: 
•  Number of current employees 

 •  Availability of staff within 50 miles of Eagle, Colorado 
•  Recruitment strategy 
•  Management approach 
Set-Aside Recommendation 
State whether the respondent believes this requirement could successfully be solicited as: 
•  Total Small Business Set-Aside 
•  HUBZone Set-Aside 
•  SDVOSB Set-Aside 
•  WOSB/EDWOSB Set-Aside 
•  8(a) Set-Aside 
•  Other (explain) 
Provide rationale supporting the recommendation. 

  6. Capability Statement Format  
Responses should not exceed five (5) pages and should include: 
1. Company Overview 
2. Socioeconomic Certifications (Must be SBA certified) 
3. Relevant Experience 
4. Staffing Approach 
5. Geographic Service Area 
6. Set-Aside Recommendation 

  7. Submission Instructions  
Responses shall be submitted electronically to: 
Contract Specialist: Curtis Landreth 
Email: curtis.r.landreth@usda.gov Subject Line: 
RFI Response – Janitorial Services – Eagle, CO 
Responses are due no later than 11/23/2026. 

  8. Disclaimer  
This RFI is for market research purposes only. The Government will not reimburse respondents for  
any costs associated with preparation or submission of responses. Any future procurement 
resulting from this market research will be announced separately.
